_source: appnotification option sets as published in the Microsoft Dataverse table reference (columns priority = global choice notification_priority, toasttype = notification_toasttype, icontype). The repo solution source (src/dataverse/solutions/SpaarkeMaster/Entities/appnotification/Entity.xml) carries only the custom sprk_ columns, so it does not hold these system option sets. Refresh from a read-only metadata describe when Microsoft changes the table; the unit test AppNotificationOptionsTests compares it with AppNotificationOptions.
